name: Malik Moiz Ahmad Awan
title: Computer Science graduate | Web, Mobile & AI/ML Developer

chunks.text: Malik Moiz Ahmad Awan (Moiz) is a Computer Science graduate from the University of Gujrat, Pakistan. He is interested in web and mobile development and AI/ML integration.
Moiz completed his BS in Computer Science at the University of Gujrat (UOG), Pakistan, in the 2022-2026 session.
Moiz wants to work in the AI/ML field after graduating, and he also plans to continue with graduate studies abroad.
Frontend: React, React Native, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap and Material UI.
Backend and data: Node.js, REST APIs, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Firebase (Auth, Storage, Messaging). He has also integrated third-party APIs such as payments and maps.
Moiz knows WordPress (themes and plugins), WooCommerce e-commerce websites, and website hosting and deployment.
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript and C++ (OOP and data structures and algorithms).

AI/ML experience: integrated the Google Gemini API for AI consultation and CNN-based image detection (TensorFlow / Teachable Machine) in PET360. Also uses AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Cursor in daily development.

Moiz's projects: PET360 (AI pet care app, Final Year Project), Cinepax Pro (cinema ticket booking web app), Coffee Shop Management System (C++ OOP and DSA), Resume Chatbot (Python AI), and the startup Blissful Art. Ask about any of them for details.

PET360 (Your Pet, Our Care) is Moiz's Final Year Project, a cross-platform pet care app with AI consultation, CNN-based skin disease detection, veterinary appointment scheduling, a marketplace and e-commerce. He was Frontend Developer and Documentation Lead. Stack: React Native, React.js admin panel, Node.js, MongoDB, Firebase, Gemini API, TensorFlow, Figma.
PET360 was considered a unique idea and the team ranked first in their Final Year Project batch.
Cinepax Pro is a cinema ticket booking web app that Moiz built solo using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript.

Coffee Shop Management System is a C++ console project using OOP (abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, templates) and DSA (BST, linked list, queue, stack, hash table, merge sort), with billing, loyalty points and stock tracking.
Resume Chatbot is this Python AI project. It answers questions about Moiz using TF-IDF retrieval, with an optional Claude API mode for natural answers, and a Streamlit chat interface.
Moiz did an internship at Nerds Studio in Full-Stack Web Development from June to August 2025, working with React.js and Firebase.
Moiz co-founded Blissful Art under NIC Cohort 6 at the Business Incubation Centre of UOG (May to October 2024) and worked as Marketing Manager, handling social media and marketing.
Moiz served as Project Manager of the Hayatiyan Computing Society at the University of Gujrat.
Moiz is from Gujrat, Punjab, Pakistan.
